insertPresOrd.title: Ordering
steps: If the input is sorted, what must be true of the output?
Think about neighboring elements in the resulting list.
Try a property involving isSorted xs and isSorted (insert x xs).

insertIncrLen.title: Size
steps: How many elements should insertion add?
Compare the length before and after insertion.
Try length (insert x xs) == length xs + 1.

insertCount.title: Count
steps: What happens if the value is already in the list?
Compare its occurrence count before and after insertion.
Check that count x (insert x xs) == count x xs + 1.

insertPresElems.title: Elements
steps: Could an implementation lose an existing element?
Consider duplicate values, not only membership.
Compare each original value’s occurrence count before and after insertion.

insertPresSubsequence.title: Relative order
steps: Think about the original list as a subsequence of the output.
A subsequence helper can test whether elements retain their relative order.

reference:
module Reference (insert) where

-- Reference behavior: insert a value into an already sorted ascending list.
insert :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int]
insert x [] = [x]
insert x ys@(y:rest)
  | x <= y    = x : ys
  | otherwise = y : insert x rest
model:
import Test.QuickCheck
import Reference (insert)
import Data.List (isSubsequenceOf)
isSorted [] = True
isSorted [_] = True
isSorted (x:y:xs) = x <= y && isSorted (y:xs)
implies x y = not x || y
count x = length . filter (== x)
insertPresOrd x xs = isSorted xs `implies` isSorted (insert x xs)
insertIncrLen x xs = length (insert x xs) == length xs + 1
insertCount x xs = count x (insert x xs) == count x xs + 1
insertPresElems x xs = all (\y -> count y (insert x xs) >= count y xs) xs
insertPresSubsequence x xs = isSubsequenceOf xs (insert x xs)
main = do
  quickCheck insertPresOrd
  quickCheck insertIncrLen
  quickCheck insertCount
  quickCheck insertPresElems
  quickCheck insertPresSubsequence

localSubsequence [] _ = True
localSubsequence _ [] = False
localSubsequence (x:xs) (y:ys)
  | x == y = localSubsequence xs ys
  | otherwise = localSubsequence (x:xs) ys
subsequenceAlternative x xs = localSubsequence xs (insert x xs)
